lab_review.design: Original offline stdlib program with no market inputs, network, stochastic draws or side effects on import/run; exact named input schemas with financial domains and strict JSON duplicate/nonfinite checks.
lab_review.cash_clock: Purchase uses dirty initial budget. Under constant-rate scenarios short maturity receipts are reinvested to the liability horizon; the long zero is then sold for its remaining maturity; pay the liability.
